simple.meaning: עֲדִיאֵל (ʻĂdîyʼêl) appears 3 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced as a son in the family line and in connection with kingship.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in 1 Chronicles, beginning at 1 Chronicles 4:36. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as family line, kingship.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to עֲדִיאֵל (H5717) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows עֲדִיאֵל through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.
simple.summary: עֲדִיאֵל (ʻĂdîyʼêl) / H5717 is tracked through 1 Chronicles 4:36, 1 Chronicles 9:12, 1 Chronicles 27:25. The entry is generated from source alignment, occurrence evidence, and the surrounding Scripture context.

definitions.short: Adiel , the name of three Israelites
definitions.full: H5717. Adiel עֲדִיאֵל proper name, masculine ( an ornament is El ; compare Sabean proper name עדאל Hal 51 Hal 2 ); — 1 a Simeonite 1Chr 4:36 , ᵐ5 A Εδιηλ , ᵐ5 L Αδαηλ . 2 a priest 1Chr 4:36 , ᵐ5 Αδιηλ . 3 father of officer, David's time 1Chr 27:25 , ᵐ5 Ωδιηλ — compare Gray Prop, N. 225, 231 .
